A row of 19th-century workers' houses on the old sea dike, squatted in 1976 to stop demolition; the Kadijkencomité fought for them, a renovation followed that put some residents out of their homes for five years, and after it damp and mould forced a rent cut (2015). Workers of the brewery De Gekroonde Valk lived here. Local voice: "de parel wil maar niet glanzen" (1018, 2015). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2015/1/26/tentjes-sibbelwoningen-hoogte-kadijk ; second: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2015/1/29/sibbelwoningen-in-het-parool and the 1018 Magazine renewal series (no. 58 to 62). Status: inhabited (2024). Caveats: private homes, front only; squat year from 1018 Magazine, needs a second source. **Nice**; new place; DE-05 can be its Look for line.
title: The Sibbelwoningen, Hoogte Kadijk 112-150
rank_text: **Nice**; new place; DE-05 can be its Look for line.

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-05. The crowned falcon on its pillar, Hoogte Kadijk.** Pin 52.368650, 4.917400 (approximate, at the brewery site; check: Location). The statue of the falcon of brewery De Gekroonde Valk, put back on its pillar in 1993; in 2017 a great-great-grandson of brewer Willem Hovy (known for his social policy, director from 1858) stopped to look at it and was invited into a Sibbelwoning to hear the story. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2017/1/9/ontmoeting-met-nazaat-van-brouwer-de-gekroonde-valk ; second: nl.wikipedia "De Gekroonde Valk" (fetched; brewery history). Status: standing (2017). **Okay**; group with DE-04.
title: The crowned falcon on its pillar, Hoogte Kadijk

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-06. Koning William yard, Hoogte Kadijk 145B (the lost fight).** Pin 52.368568, 4.918878. One of the last shipyards on the old dike; residents ("Wakkere Kadijkers") sought monument status, which the stadsdeel refused in 2018 (the committee granted it rarity value but not enough architecture), lost their appeal, and the Raad van State allowed housing in Feb 2023; the yard closed in Dec 2017 and a corten tower now stands. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2018/11/19/aanvraag-monumentenstatus-werfterrein-koning-william-hoogte-kadijk-afgewezen ; second: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2023/2/1/raad-van-state-staat-nieuwbouw-koning-william-toe . Status: new building (2026). Caveats: gone yard, high bar: keep only as part of a Hoogte Kadijk item. **Okay**; group with DE-04 or DE-07.
title: Koning William yard, Hoogte Kadijk 145B (the lost fight)

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-07. Hoogte Kadijk, the sea dike that still works.** Pin 52.368400, 4.917800 (on the dike road; approximate). The street is a dike of the Zuiderzee era; on 2 Nov 2023, during storm Ciarán, the city shut 14 sluices for the first time in 25 years, and the dike streets (Hoogte Kadijk, Zeeburgerdijk, Zeedijk) were again the city's water barrier. Local voice: 1018 Magazine's piece on how well the inner city is protected. Lead: 1018 Magazine 64 (Dec 2024), https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/s/1018-Magazine-64-dec-2024.pdf ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hoogte_Kadijk . Status: in use. Caveats: the 14 sluices and "25 years" rest on 1018 Magazine; a drafter should find the Waternet source. Energetica (coal power station until 1950) is a Look for line. **Nice**; new place (would carry DE-05 and DE-06 if the user wants fewer pins).
title: Hoogte Kadijk, the sea dike that still works
rank_text: **Nice**; new place (would carry DE-05 and DE-06 if the user wants fewer pins).

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-08. The Marineterrein wall, Kattenburgerstraat.** Pin 52.371804, 4.916275 (Kattenburgerstraat 5, at the wall). For centuries the navy yard was a closed world behind this wall; much of it is the back walls of vanished buildings; it became a municipal monument in April 2023. Behind it since 2015: the former shooting range rebuilt with a roof garden (2023), the Binnenhaven as the first official swimming spot of the centre (from April 2025), and the Buurtboerderij Ons Genoegen, which residents fought to keep (2026). Local voice: a blogger took apart Defence's case for keeping the site (2019); the swimming that used to draw fines. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2023/4/24/muur-marineterrein-wordt-gemeentelijk-monument ; second: https://nltimes.nl/2025/02/21/amsterdam-promises-new-official-swimming-hole-city-center . Status: open grounds (Sept 2026). Caveats: the farm's permit ran out (left mid-Sept 2026 per 1018 Magazine 74); theme B or C scouts may propose the Marineterrein as a whole: merge there. **Nice**; new place.
title: The Marineterrein wall, Kattenburgerstraat

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-09. Oosterkerk, the church the neighbours saved.** Pin 52.369988, 4.919306. Closed in 1963 as unsafe, bought by the city in 1969, which planned to demolish it in the renewal of the islands until residents stopped it; now a free concert hall and the islands' meeting place, scene of the 2018 memorial for Mohamed Bouchikhi (see DE-10) and of a fight over the elm in front of it (57 objections, 2015). Local voice: Maria Bervoets's photo book "Oosterkerk, hart van de buurt" (2021). Lead: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oosterkerk_(Amsterdam) ; second: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2015/11/8/strijd-om-boom-voor-oosterkerk . Status: in use (2026). Caveats: listed (rijksmonument); a monument scout may take it: merge the local story in. **Nice**; new place.
title: Oosterkerk, the church the neighbours saved

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-10. Memorial stone for Mohamed Bouchikhi, Wittenburg playground.** Pin 52.371348, 4.921531 (speeltuin by De Witte Boei; check: Location). Unveiled by the family and mayor Halsema on 26 Jan 2019, a year after his violent death, after a full Oosterkerk and a silent march. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2019/1/26/indrukwekkende-herdenking-mohamed-bouchikhi-in-de-oosterkerk-en-onthulling-gedenksteen . Status: 2019, no later evidence. Caveats: recent death of a private person, sensitive; only one source; better as a Look for line in DE-09. **Okay**; group with DE-09.
title: Memorial stone for Mohamed Bouchikhi, Wittenburg playground

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-11. Aat Veldhoen's house with the palette, Wittenburgergracht.** Pin 52.369706, 4.920070 (Wittenburgergracht 241; check: Location). The painter and printmaker (1934-2018), arrested in the 1960s for spreading "indecent" prints of lovers and nudes, lived on the Wittenburgergracht in a house marked by a big painter's palette and kept a studio in the Grote Wittenburgerstraat; after a stroke in 2004 he taught himself to paint left-handed. Wikipedia shows his gable stone at Wittenburgergracht 241 (1992). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2018/12/9/aat-veldhoen-overleden ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aat_Veldhoen . Status: palette and stone not checked since 2018. Caveats: private house; whether the palette house is no. 241 is not confirmed (check: Location). **Okay**; new place.
title: Aat Veldhoen's house with the palette, Wittenburgergracht

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-12. Nijlpaardenbrug, roses, swimmers and the oboe maker's ship.** Pin 52.368788, 4.913981. The hippo bridge between Artis and the Entrepotdok is the islands' informal swimming spot and a stage for small rituals (65 red roses hung on it for a birthday boat, 1 Sept 2018); iamsterdam sends people here for the view of the warehouses. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2018/9/1/65-rode-rozen-aan-de-nijlpaardenbrug ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijlpaardenbrug and https://www.iamsterdam.com/ontdek/buurten/de-plantage/verborgen-parels . Status: standing. Caveats: thin as a place on its own; stronger as the pin for "the animal bridges of 1018" (Kippebrug, Ezelsbrug, Pelikaanbrug, Oliphantsbrug, named 2014 with a wink to Artis). **Okay**; new place.
title: Nijlpaardenbrug, roses, swimmers and the oboe maker's ship

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-13. Entrepotdok chestnut and quay.** Pin 52.369680, 4.911334 (approximate, Entrepotdok west end; check: Location). In 2019 the sagging quay wall was to be rebuilt and the giant monumental chestnut felled; residents organised; the quay collapsed under a houseboat in Dec 2017. Also the "Dokoproer" of 10 Dec 2022 against selling social housing on the dock, which made the corporation back down. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2019/7/10/kapdreiging-monumentale-kastanjeboom-entrepotdok-kom-donderdag-11-juli-1900-u-naar-t-kromhoutar ; second: 1018 Magazine 54 (April 2023). Status: whether the chestnut survived is not found (check: Still there?). **Okay**; new place, or Look for lines in an Entrepotdok place by another scout.
title: Entrepotdok chestnut and quay
rank_text: **Okay**; new place, or Look for lines in an Entrepotdok place by another scout.

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-14. Werkspoorhal, the hall residents want open.** Pin 52.372682, 4.927932. The 1929 Werkspoor hall on Oostenburg, one of two kept (decision of Dec 2015); the 2024-25 plan for padel courts met protest from neighbours (fine with sport, not with padel noise), then BigGym, with public access promised. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2015/12/17/besluit-werkspoorhallen-op-oostenburg-n-van-de-twee-blijft-behouden ; second: 1018 Magazine 65 to 69 (2025). Status: in use (2025). Caveats: theme C overlap; the Van Gendthallen next door are nearly done (May 2026). **Nice**; new place.
title: Werkspoorhal, the hall residents want open

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-15. Tkramrepus, the supermarket in reverse, Czaar Peterstraat 233.** Pin 52.371584, 4.931617. "Supermarkt" spelled backwards: you bring groceries instead of taking them, and people with a food bank pass or Stadspas shop free; opened Dec 2022, saved by crowdfunding in 2024 (30,000 euro goal). Local voice: the Czaar Peterstraat's own social institution. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2024/7/1/crowdfunding-moet-sluiting-supermarkt-tkramrepus-voorkomen ; second: OSM node "Tkramrepus" (amenity social_facility); a news source to find. Status: open 2024; not checked for 2026 (check: Still there?). **Nice**; new place.
title: Tkramrepus, the supermarket in reverse, Czaar Peterstraat 233

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-16. Hondenliefhebbersbankje, the dog lovers' bench by the railway.** Pin 52.372000, 4.931500 (approximate, dog field by the railway along the Czaar Peterstraat; the field itself may lie across the borough line in Oost: an earlier guess at 52.372500, 4.933000 point-checked as Oost; check: Location). A home-made bench with "hondenliefhebbersbankje" carved in the seat and a back of three old café chair backs carved with the names of the dogs that come here, plus commands ("af", "zit", "pootje"); a tree-trunk bench opposite has the same treatment. The field went from brambles to plantsoen to fenced dog run. Lead: 1018 Magazine 49 (2022), https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/s/Buurtmagazine-1018-nr-49.pdf . Status: 2022, no later evidence; only one source (check: Still there?). **Okay**; new place.
title: Hondenliefhebbersbankje, the dog lovers' bench by the railway

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-17. Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat, "het schattigste straatje".** Pin 52.370250, 4.923574 (Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat 10). Workers' houses of 1871 with postage-stamp front gardens and benches under the kitchen windows, backing onto the Wittenburgervaart; a 1018 Magazine portrait calls it "met stip het schattigste straatje op de Oostelijke Eilanden". Lead: 1018 Magazine 2025 (portrait of a resident film-maker); second: monument register to check. Status: inhabited. Caveats: one local source for the nickname; check listing status. **Okay**; new place.
title: Nieuwe Oostenburgerstraat, "het schattigste straatje"

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-18. Touwbaanpark and the 400-year fence, Oostenburg.** Pin 52.369830, 4.922950 (Touwbaanpark). The park on the line of the VOC's old rope walk; first container gardens of Centrum here (2020); along the railway a 300 m building fence by Josje-Marie Vrolijk tells 400 years of Oostenburg (2023, to stay until at least 2028). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2023/2/25/400-jaar-geschiedenis-van-oostenburg-op-schutting-langs-het-spoor ; second: OSM Touwbaanpark; nl.wikipedia Oostenburg (to read). Status: fence until 2028 (Outlook: Leaving or closing, "2028 or later"). **Nice**; new place.
title: Touwbaanpark and the 400-year fence, Oostenburg

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-19. Tonia Stieltjesplein, Oostenburg.** Pin 52.371606, 4.930568. The new square was named in 2025 by residents' choice (twenty suggestions) after Tonia Stieltjes (1881-1932), a Black trade-union woman, portrayed by Iris Kensmil (2023). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2025/5/30/buurtplein-oostenburg-wordt-genoemd-naar-tonia-stieltjes ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tonia_Stieltjes . Status: named 2025. Caveats: little to see beyond the sign; Look for: the "groen intiem asfaltpleintje" by the Zonnewendebrug that residents redesigned (May 2026). **Okay**; new place.
title: Tonia Stieltjesplein, Oostenburg

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-20. Museum Werf 't Kromhout, 50 years.** Pin 52.368120, 4.920180. A working 19th-century shipyard turned museum of the Kromhout engine (ships, then trucks, buses, pumping stations); 50 years old in 2025; it hosts the neighbourhood meetings (the chestnut fight of 2019 was argued here). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2025/4/28/museum-t-kromhout-viert-50-jarig-bestaan ; second: OSM (tourism=museum); Stadsherstel. Status: open (2025). Caveats: listed; theme C overlap. **Nice**; new place.
title: Museum Werf 't Kromhout, 50 years

heading: Oostelijke Eilanden/Kadijken
text: **DE-21. The railway tunnel under the Dijksgracht, a graffiti free zone in the making.** Pin 52.376500, 4.913500 (approximate, pedestrian tunnel between Dijksgracht and Piet Heinkade; check: Location). A tunnel known for rough sleepers and bike wrecks is to become "the Hall of Fame", a legal graffiti wall by Amsterdam Street Art with the Ambassade hotel (project "Rafel", announced Aug 2026). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2026/8/19/kunstvrijplaats-en-horeca-in-plaats-van-daklozen-onder-de-spoorbrug-bij-de-dijksgracht . Status: plan (Outlook: Major change ahead). Caveats: one source, not yet built. **Okay**; new place, or hold until it opens.
title: The railway tunnel under the Dijksgracht, a graffiti free zone in the making
rank_text: **Okay**; new place, or hold until it opens.

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-22. Schaduwkade, the quay that remembers.** Pin 52.365070, 4.904029. Since 2013 the quay of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht carries, opposite their houses, the names of about 200 Jewish residents taken away during the war: a residents' initiative. Because passengers of moored party boats showed no respect, the stadsdeel strung a yellow ball line around Koningsdag 2024, and from mid-April 2025 a permanent red ball line keeps boats off most of the quay. Local voice: residents across the water "enthousiast" about the ball line. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2025/4/18/ballenlint-beschermt-schaduwkade ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schaduwkade and https://www.hmdb.org/m.asp?m=113425 . Status: in place (April 2025). Caveats: theme A overlap; the three Kok plaques are Look for lines. **Amazing**; new place.
title: Schaduwkade, the quay that remembers

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-23. Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid, the monument nobody wanted next door.** Pin 52.361922, 4.907939 (Wikipedia coordinates, Weesperplein). The 1950 thank-you to Amsterdammers who helped Jews in the war; moved for the metro to the Weesperstraat, then again for the Holocaust Namenmonument; in 2017 residents of the Overloopplantsoen fiercely refused it in their park; stored in 2020, it returned to the Weesperplein green strip in Feb 2021. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2017/11/19/overloopplantsoen-bewoners-fel-tegen-komst-monument-van-joodse-erkentelijkheid ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monument_van_Joodse_Erkentelijkheid . Status: in place (2021). Caveats: theme A overlap; check whether the Weesperplein pin is in Weesperbuurt/Plantage (it is, point-checked). **Nice**; new place.
title: Monument van Joodse Erkentelijkheid, the monument nobody wanted next door

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-24. The Stolperschwelle at the tram stop, Plantage Middenlaan.** Pin 52.366300, 4.909600 (tram stop opposite the Hollandsche Schouwburg; check: Location). Gunter Demnig's wide stumbling threshold: "In 1942 and 1943 tens of thousands of people were deported from here by municipal tram because they were Jewish". A threshold, not a stone: for the many, not the one. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2025/1/31/struikeldrempel-geplaatst-op-de-tramhalte-bij-de-hollandsche-schouwburg ; second needed (NH Nieuws or Stolpersteine Amsterdam). Status: placed Jan 2025 (the 1018 text says "eind februari" in a post of 31 Jan: date to settle, check: Facts). Caveats: beside the A-list Hollandsche Schouwburg, pitched on itself; the boulders laid on the pavements for museum security in Feb 2024 are a Look for line. **Nice**; new place.
title: The Stolperschwelle at the tram stop, Plantage Middenlaan

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-25. The Caucasian wingnut "IJzeren Hein", Wertheimpark.** Pin 52.367865, 4.908654 (tree beside the Auschwitz monument; check: Location). No. 9 in the experts' top ten of the city's monumental trees (2022): nearly 4 m round, so far gone in the 1970s that it was held together with iron anchors, hence the nickname. Local voice: the nickname; Ko van Geemert's poem plaque in the park (2012) is a Look for line. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2022/10/28/vleugelnoot-uit-wertheimpark-in-bomen-top-tien ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wertheimpark (tree 3750). Caveats: planting year disputed (1018 says 1860, Wikipedia about 1900: check: Facts); the Wertheim fountain is already drafted in plantage-1.yaml: could be merged there. **Nice**; new place or merge into "Wertheim fountain (Wertheimpark)".
title: The Caucasian wingnut "IJzeren Hein", Wertheimpark
rank_text: **Nice**; new place or merge into "Wertheim fountain (Wertheimpark)".

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-26. Mahatma Gandhi Plantsoen, the houseboat dweller's park.** Pin 52.368228, 4.913690 (OSM garden). At the end of the Plantage Kerklaan, a pocket park laid out by houseboat dweller Roy, who put up the name board himself; a worm hotel opened here on 21 April 2018. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2018/4/20/wormenhotel-in-mahatma-gandhiplantsoen ; second: OSM (leisure=garden, name). Status: 2018, nothing later (check: Still there?). Caveats: name unofficial; the resident is a private person (no surname given, keep it so). **Okay**; new place.
title: Mahatma Gandhi Plantsoen, the houseboat dweller's park

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-27. Ramses Shaffy on the Sarphatihuis, Roetersstraat.** Pin 52.364697, 4.910550 (Roetersstraat 2; check: Location of the wall). A portrait of the singer on the outer wall of the care home where he lived for years, almost unreadable under graffiti until it was restored and "re-unveiled" by mayor Halsema on 29 Aug 2023, his 90th birthday. The Sarphatihuis began as a workhouse where work was compulsory until 1957 (1018 Magazine; staff podcast 2025). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2023/8/30/ramses-shaffy-straalt-weer ; second: OSM "Ramses Shaffy Huis" is a different home on Oostenburg: a drafter should find a second source for the mural. Status: restored 2023. **Nice**; new place.
title: Ramses Shaffy on the Sarphatihuis, Roetersstraat

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-28. "De buurt borduurt", the embroidered wall, Weesperstraat 100.** Pin 52.364920, 4.905512. A 4 by 8 m embroidery hung on a bare wall at the corner of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht on 29 June 2024, started by Gerda Leeffers of textile studio Studio Koekoek against the grey of the Weesperstraat and stitched by 277 neighbours; an XL follow-up started in 2026. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2024/7/1/borduurwerk-weesperstraat-onthuld ; second: 1018 Magazine 61 (June 2024). Status: 2024 (check: Still there? textile outdoors). **Nice**; new place.
title: "De buurt borduurt", the embroidered wall, Weesperstraat 100

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-29. Johnnyspot, the freerunners' square behind Carré.** Pin 52.363227, 4.907712 (Lepelpleintje by the Lepelkruisstraat; check: Location). The low walls and level changes of the Lepelpleintje make it a top spot of Amsterdam freerunning, known as "Johnnyspot" after its mural; the scene's best gave a demonstration in Sept 2023; neighbours complain of noise. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2023/9/21/freerunners-geven-demonstratie-in-weesperbuurt ; second needed (a freerun site). Status: 2023. **Okay**; new place.
title: Johnnyspot, the freerunners' square behind Carré

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-30. Urban Jungle, Sarphatistraat 163.** Pin 52.362489, 4.913452. Tim Rodermans's life-size mural (June 2024) of a boy "looking out to his future", meant as a moment of stillness on a traffic strip, backed by residents and the owner Lieven de Key. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2024/6/25/urban-jungle-in-de-sarphatistraat ; second: Street Art Cities or the city's wall-art register (theme A scout). Status: 2024. **Okay**; new place, or theme A's list.
title: Urban Jungle, Sarphatistraat 163
rank_text: **Okay**; new place, or theme A's list.

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-31. Petit Versailles, the courtyard park that stayed green.** Pin 52.363300, 4.912300 (approximate, behind the Sarphatistraat on the Roeterseiland campus; check: Location). A neighbourhood park on the university campus where the UvA meant to build a large teaching building; after years of resistance by Sarphatistraat residents the plan was dropped (Feb 2021, announced in Folia). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2021/2/3/petit-versailles-blijft-groen ; second: Folia (to find). Status: green (2021). Caveats: access hours of the campus grounds to check. **Okay**; new place.
title: Petit Versailles, the courtyard park that stayed green

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-32. Hubertushuis, Aldo van Eyck's colour house for single parents.** Pin 52.366780, 4.911324 (Plantage Middenlaan 33). Built 1973-80 by Van Eyck with Theo Bosch for the Hubertus association, a refuge for single parents and children ("het Moederhuis"), a small town of passages and roof terraces in every colour, joined to two 19th-century houses; named a rijksmonument in Sept 2025. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2025/9/30/hubertushuis-nieuw-rijksmonument ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hubertushuis . Status: in use, front only. Caveats: theme C will also have it: merge. **Nice**; new place.
title: Hubertushuis, Aldo van Eyck's colour house for single parents

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-33. Hildo Krop's studio, Plantage Muidergracht 105.** Pin 52.364132, 4.915246. The former studio of the city sculptor, subject of a long fight (2016: Stichting Onze Plantage wrote to the city's leaders about a deal they called close to cronyism over its future); Krop's Gea is on the Nieuwe Prinsengracht 130 nearby. Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2016/7/4/conflict-over-toekomst-voormalig-atelier-hildo-krop-aan-de-plantage-muidergracht ; second: 1018 Magazine 52/53. Status: outcome of the fight not found. Caveats: sides by institution only; check what stands there now. **Okay**; new place.
title: Hildo Krop's studio, Plantage Muidergracht 105

heading: Weesperbuurt/Plantage
text: **DE-34. Weesperflat, the student block of 1966.** Pin 52.365784, 4.905537. Herman Hertzberger's student flat at the start of the Weesperstraat, owned by De Key; at 50 (2016) about a thousand former residents came back for a festival. Local voice: the alumni festival; the poem "Wibautotisme" under the Vaz Diasbrug next door (1982) belongs to the Nieuwmarkt/Lastage side (lead). Lead: https://www.buurtorganisatie1018.nl/nieuws-uit-1018/2016/7/28/weesperflat-50-jaar ; second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weesperflat . Status: in use. Caveats: theme C overlap. **Nice**; new place.
title: Weesperflat, the student block of 1966

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-35. Speeltuin UJ Klaren, the first public playground in the country.** Pin 52.358777, 4.892067 (OSM playground, Tweede Weteringplantsoen). On 8 May 1880 the first public children's playground of the Netherlands opened here, free for all, on the park laid out about 1845 on the old bastion De Wetering; local papers call it "de oudste speeltuin van Amsterdam". In 2025-26 the plantsoen was redone: the 1975 pancake house demolished, the playground moved, the Van Randwijk monument shifted, and since May 2026 it reopens as part of "Het Weteringpark", a name residents are still getting used to. Krop's Moeder Aarde (a replica) stands here. Lead: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weteringplantsoen ; second: De Binnenkrant 93 (https://oudestadt.nl/wp-content/uploads/Binnenkrant93.pdf) and De nieuwe VijzelCourant editie 2, 2026 (https://denieuwevijzelcourant.nl/editie-2/). Status: reopened end May 2026. Caveats: the 1880 "first" rests on Wikipedia: a drafter must find the archive source. **Amazing**; new place (Van Randwijk monument and Moeder Aarde as Look for lines).
title: Speeltuin UJ Klaren, the first public playground in the country
rank_text: **Amazing**; new place (Van Randwijk monument and Moeder Aarde as Look for lines).

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-36. Kruidenpluktuin, Eerste Weteringplantsoen.** Pin 52.360183, 4.888242 (OSM garden, opposite Carl Denig). In 2014 neighbours turned a dog-fouling lawn into a public herb garden anyone may pick from; work afternoons every Friday, autumn markets and a cocktail party with herbal snacks. Same plantsoen: the execution of 30 political prisoners on 12 March 1945 (monument Fusillade) and the 4 May gathering at the Gevallen Hoornblazer. Lead: De Binnenkrant 70 (2015) and 99 (2022), https://oudestadt.nl/wp-content/uploads/Binnenkrant99.pdf ; second: OSM "Kruidenpluktuin Weteringbuurt"; Wetering Groen. Status: active (Binnenkrant 101, 2023). **Nice**; new place.
title: Kruidenpluktuin, Eerste Weteringplantsoen

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-37. Blauw Jan, forty bronze lizards, Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen.** Pin 52.363900, 4.883900 (the lawn; approximate). Since 1994 forty life-size monitor lizards, agamas and iguanas by Hans van Houwelingen crawl about the little fenced lawn beside the Leidseplein; they vanished and were put back in 2021 ("Foetsie"); in 2025 residents noted the lizards' lawn had shrunk and a row of trees was gone. Lead: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen ; second: https://www.priveekollektie.art/work/blauw-jan/ and De Binnenkrant 94 and 107. Status: in place (Binnenkrant 107, 2025). Caveats: beside the A-list Leidseplein, pitched on itself; theme A overlap; De Kring (DE-38) is next door. **Nice**; new place.
title: Blauw Jan, forty bronze lizards, Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-38. Sociëteit De Kring, Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen 7.** Pin 52.363615, 4.883504. The artists' club, 100 years old in 2022, now also a venue for the neighbourhood (buurtborrels, Binnenkrant 2026). Lead: De Binnenkrant 99 (2022) ; second: dekring.nl. Status: open. Caveats: a members' club; check what non-members can see or attend. **Okay**; group with DE-37.
title: Sociëteit De Kring, Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen 7

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-39. Leidse Dwarstuin, Lange Leidsedwarsstraat.** Pin 52.364023, 4.884380 (approximate; check: Location). A walled neighbourhood garden and play space in the tourist strip, with a big mural by Gerti Bierenbroodspot (2019), redone in 2024-25. Local voice: "een oase van rust" (Binnenkrant 106). Lead: https://oudestadt.nl/wp-content/uploads/Binnenkrant106.pdf ; second needed. Status: 2025. **Okay**; new place.
title: Leidse Dwarstuin, Lange Leidsedwarsstraat

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-40. Monument Kinderverzet, Falckstraat.** Pin 52.360249, 4.897356 (Falckstraat 10, the plantsoentje; check: Location). The play equipment of a small plantsoen turned into an interactive monument for the children's resistance and friendship of the former Catharina Wilhelminaschool in the war, opened to great interest (2024). Lead: https://oudestadt.nl/wp-content/uploads/Binnenkrant106.pdf ; second: kinderverzet.nl. Status: 2024. Caveats: theme A overlap. **Nice**; new place.
title: Monument Kinderverzet, Falckstraat

heading: De Weteringschans
text: **DE-44. De Nederlandsche Bank's garden, open since 2025, Frederiksplein.** Pin 52.359364, 4.900123 (Frederiksplein 61; point-checked as De Weteringschans, not Grachtengordel-Zuid). After its rebuild (Duintjer's tower and Mecanoo's addition), the bank opened a jetty by the water and its inner garden to the public from 4 March 2025. Local voice: the VijzelCourant welcomed the bank "back in our neighbourhood". Lead: https://denieuwevijzelcourant.nl/archief-2/ (No. 1, 2025) ; second: dnb.nl. Status: open 2025 (check hours). **Okay**; new place.
title: De Nederlandsche Bank's garden, open since 2025, Frederiksplein

heading: Grachtengordel-Zuid
text: **DE-41. Amstelveld, the square of the wooden church.** Pin 52.362321, 4.896482 (Amstelveld 10). The square by the mostly wooden Amstelkerk (1668-70): Monday flower market, brocante days, "Klassiek op het Amstelveld", the start of the Pride Walk (26 July 2025), a statue of the market crier Kokadorus. De Dogger (1865), "the oldest houseboat in Amsterdam", left the Prinsengracht here in 2022. Local voice: the Amstelveldbuurt association meets about it four times a year; Pride Walk. Lead: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amstelveld ; second: https://oudestadt.nl/wp-content/uploads/Binnenkrant99.pdf (De Dogger) and https://amstelveldbuurt.wordpress.com/ . Status: in use (2026). Caveats: Amstelkerk is listed; the place should be pitched on the square's life. **Nice**; new place.
title: Amstelveld, the square of the wooden church

heading: Grachtengordel-Zuid
text: **DE-42. Keizersgrachtkerk and its plaque, Keizersgracht 566.** Pin 52.364659, 4.888117. A plaque on the church recalls shootings in November 1944; the church now hosts neighbourhood fairs. Lead: De Binnenkrant (kwic hit, issue to cite); second: 4en5mei.nl (theme A). Status: in use (Nov 2026). Caveats: thin; better a theme A item; listed. **Okay**; new place or theme A.
title: Keizersgrachtkerk and its plaque, Keizersgracht 566

heading: Grachtengordel-Zuid
text: **DE-43. Halvemaansteeg 4-6, the illegal demolition.** Pin 52.366731, 4.895714. In 2014 the owner of Halvemaansteeg 6 and the linked Amstel 46 demolished almost all of both, houses with medieval structures, without a permit; the Vrienden van de Amsterdamse Binnenstad found out; in 2025 the site was still "waiting for its renovation". Lead: https://oudestadt.nl/wp-content/uploads/Binnenkrant81.pdf (Binnenkrant 81) ; second: Binnenkrant 105 and the VVAB (not readable today). Status: unfinished (2025). Caveats: gone thing (high bar): there is a gap to stand at; one source family. **Okay**; new place.
title: Halvemaansteeg 4-6, the illegal demolition

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-01 Het Gangenproject: the vanished alleys of the Willemsstraat in the pavement.** Pin 52.381436, 4.885284, information panel on the side wall of Willemsstraat 22; the tiles run between numbers 22 and 110. The filled-in Goudsbloemgracht had some 57 alleys (gangen) to slum courts behind the fronts; a handful survive. The Jordaanmuseum (Mieke Krijger, with architect Yuri Werner) proposed in 2006 to mark them in the pavement, and it took nine years: unveiled 5 March 2015 with the re-laid street, a panel of old maps and photos, and a monthly alley walk. Local voice: Krijger calls it "een Lieu de Memoire, èn een eerbetoon aan de stratenmakers"; her quiz on the walk: "Wie weet het verschil tussen een gang en een steeg?". The slum landlord Jacobus Mens (1805 to 1869) was "De Bokkebek", "de burgemeester van de Willemsstraat". Lead: WJGR 2006, 00000083; 2015, 00000015 p1 and p3; 2017, 00000112 p4; 2021, 00000191 p9. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Willemsstraat_(Amsterdam). Status: panel there 2017; WJGR 2023 (00000202) "24 uur per dag te zien". Caveats: counts differ (56 in 1778 in the paper, 57 in 1775 on Wikipedia); who made the tiles is credited to the Jordaanmuseum, design Jaap Elzas. Rank **Amazing**. New place.
title: Het Gangenproject: the vanished alleys of the Willemsstraat in the pavement

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-02 The anonymous sculptor of the Anjeliersstraat.** Pin 52.377028, 4.880194, the harmonica player on the front of Anjeliersstraat 175. Small iron figures appear on Jordaan walls with no maker: the "(trek)harmonicaspeler" placed "in het holst van de nacht" in 1994, street-organ figures at Anjeliersstraat 82 (2010/2011), a figure on the street-lamp cable at the Eerste Anjeliersdwarsstraat, and one on café Het Bruine Paard that went missing in 2015. Wikipedia credits them to an Amsterdam doctor who wants to stay anonymous, the same hand as the Boomzagertje and the Violist; the girl on skates "Madeliefje" (2007) on the Madelievenplein was wrecked three times and stolen in 2010. Local voice: the Wijkkrant calls them "geveltoeristen" and ran "Opsporing verzocht: Geveltoerist vermist" (2016), adding "Geruchten gaan dat koningin Beatrix ze heeft vervaardigd"; What's up with Amsterdam repeats the Beatrix rumour. Lead: WJGR 2016, 00000002; WJGR 2007, 00000073/74/76 (Madeliefje). Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lijst_van_beelden_in_Amsterdam-Centrum (rows 1994, 2007, 2010/2011); https://whatsupwithamsterdam.com/the-mystery-of-the-sculptures/. Status: harmonica man photographed on Wikipedia (undated); Wijkkrant 2016. Caveats: how many figures remain needs a walk; the 2007 Wijkkrant "Monument voor de Onbekende Hond" on the Madelievenplein was an April Fools' joke and never existed. Rank **Nice**. New place (group the street's figures under one pin).
title: The anonymous sculptor of the Anjeliersstraat
rank_text: Rank **Nice**. New place (group the street's figures under one pin).

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-03 Kees de jongen on the "Tuinpleintje".** Pin 52.377240, 4.883540, side wall of Tuinstraat 61. Theo Thijssen's Jordaan schoolboy, after Dick Matena's 2012 comic, painted by Ellen Bouman and Ed Simons in September 2025, paid from Centrum Begroot after a Theo Thijssen Museum volunteer saw Matena's Kees on a comics wall in Antwerp; a first wall fell through because one neighbour opposite was against it; pupils of the Theo Thijssenschool sang the Kees de jongen song at the unveiling. Local voice: "de jongen die na ruim honderd jaar 'thuis' kwam"; locals call the spot "het Tuinpleintje". Lead: WJGR 2025, 00000219 and 00000220 p3; 2026, 00000226 p1. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muurschildering_Kees_de_jongen. Status: there November 2026. Caveat: day of unveiling (Friday 12 September 2025 per the announcement). Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Kees de jongen on the "Tuinpleintje"

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-04 Bevrijdingslinde van Jordaankinderen.** Pin 52.377630, 4.879982 (pin approximate: the plantsoen at the corner of Westerstraat and Marnixstraat). A lime planted on 4 May 1946, paid by the pupils of thirteen Jordaan schools, for the liberation and for the Jordaan children who did not survive the war; an urn with their names lies under it; the stone came in 1949. In 1984 a substation was to replace it; after three years of protest the substation went next to it (1987) and the stone onto a column. In 2021 residents fought its use as a dog toilet and urinal. Local voice: headline "Bewoners verzetten zich tegen oorlogsmonument als pispaaltje"; "Ook de sokkel is soms letterlijk 'het pispaaltje'". Lead: WJGR 2021, 00000191 p1 and p3. Second: https://tracesofwar.com/sights/28322/Bevrijdingslinde-Jordaankinderen-Amsterdam.htm (lime on the Marnixplein, inscription 4 May 1946); a 1950 photo "Defilé langs bevrijdingslinde" on Wikimedia Commons. Status: tree and stone there April 2021. Rank **Nice** (Amazing if the urn checks out). New place.
title: Bevrijdingslinde van Jordaankinderen
rank_text: Rank **Nice** (Amazing if the urn checks out). New place.

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-05 Noordermarkt: what the locals point at.** Pin 52.379750, 4.886185 (pin approximate, the square by the Noorderkerk). Not the market: (1) the bronze plaque on the Noorderkerk for the protest meeting of February 1941 that sent out the strike call, found by a dog walker in late 2010 leaning against a house in the Boomstraat after bronze thieves dropped it; (2) "een raadselachtig paaltje" by the Woutertje Pieterse statue, remnant of the second tap of clean dune water (a cent a bucket; the first was at the Haarlemmerpoort), with the basin still in the ground; (3) the old churchyard outline laid in the paving; (4) the corner of the Prinsengracht where the wall was hacked away to fit the street sign; (5) the Christmas tree that "kerstboomvrouw" Mireille of the Lindengracht fought back from the cuts in 2025 and 2026 (children hang the baubles, café Hegeraad lends the ladder). Local voice: "zijn er in de Jordaan bronsdieven actief?" (2010); "bij de gemeente als een leeuwin gevochten" (2026). Lead: WJGR 2010, 00000057 p8; 2016, 00000006; 2026, 00000221 pp8 to 9; 2026, 00000226 p1. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Lijst_van_beelden_in_Amsterdam-Centrum (Monument Jordaanoproer and the Noorderkerk plaque rows). Status: February and November 2026. Caveats: whether the 2010 plaque was put back is not in the paper (check on site); the tree is seasonal and its future is "ongewis" with halved budgets. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Noordermarkt: what the locals point at

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-06 Jaco's gable stone: the folk hero who never was.** Pin 52.369217, 4.880005, Elandsgracht 73 (stone on 71 to 77, listed). The stone recalls Jacob Frederik Muller, "Jaco", executed 1718, in Jordaan legend a Robin Hood with a fort full of secret passages on this spot. In 2007 a thesis by Frans Thuijs took it apart, and the Wijkkrant printed: "Jaco was geen Amsterdammer. Het fort van Jaco heeft nooit bestaan. En Jaco was helemaal geen Robin Hood". Local voice: a reader from the Prinsengracht, "De Jordaan is dus een mythe kwijt." Lead: WJGR 2007, 00000074 p3 and 00000078 p3; 2008, 00000068 p7. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_van_Sjako (the fort probably an invention of Justus van Maurik, 1901). Status: stone there (Wikipedia photo). Caveat: the squat Fort van Sjakoo (Jodenbreestraat) borrows the name: not this. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Jaco's gable stone: the folk hero who never was

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-07 Johnny Jordaanplein: the people's statue garden.** Pin 52.370150, 4.882267, head of the Elandsgracht at the Prinsengracht. Five busts of Jordaan singers (1991 to 2010) on a square built as a witkar station, a name the council never formally gave. In 2005 canal-belt residents planned a fountain square with the statues swept into a heap; the self-appointed keeper collected 500 signatures in two days and Manke Nelis was unveiled by mayor Cohen on 30 October 2005; in 2010 René Froger paid for his parents' statue himself, to the borough's surprise. Local voice: the keeper on the planners, "ik noem ze altijd de hondenclub"; the paper calls her "de burgemeester van het Johnny Jordaanplein"; she nailed up the name sign herself. Lead: WJGR 2005, 00000086 p5 and 00000091 p1; 2010, 00000057; 2015, 00000014 p4. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johnny_Jordaanplein. Status: Wikipedia photo 2024. Caveat: well known to Amsterdammers; pitch the self-management and fights. Rank **Nice**. New place (keep the 1880 krul on the square as a Look for).
title: Johnny Jordaanplein: the people's statue garden
rank_text: Rank **Nice**. New place (keep the 1880 krul on the square as a Look for).

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-08 Gedenksteen Bloemgracht 82.** Pin 52.374874, 4.880850, Bloemgracht 82. The upper floors were a base and arms store of the Raad van Verzet; Ko Stevense, Jan Keune and Durk Wolters died in the house shortly before the liberation. A new stone went on the front on 4 May 2014; the third-floor resident has held an "Open Verzetshuis" with relatives' stories. Lead: WJGR 2013, 00000039 p5; 2014, 00000024; 2023, 00000201. Second: none found. Status: 2023 (plaque text quoted). Caveat: private house, plaque only. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Gedenksteen Bloemgracht 82

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-09 De Reus van Bickerseiland.** Pin 52.384881, 4.890289, corner Touwslagerstraat and Hollandse Tuin. A 1.70 m wooden Roman soldier, a 1951 replica (by old ship's carpenter D. Rijnsdorp) of the figure that stood on Jan Bicker's house and later on the gate of machine works Jonker & Zoon. When Jonker left in 1972 the director took it to Alicante; from 2000 islanders searched for almost ten years, found it with a grandson in Canada in 2006, it nearly went down in a storm off Cape Verde, came back in 2009 and was unveiled by mayor Van der Laan on a plinth by island artist Egon Schrama with a line by a neighbour cut in the steel. Local voice: "de houten nachtwacht en tot voor kort verdwaalde mascotte van Bickerseiland"; "maar een meter zeventig hoog, niet echt een reus dus". Lead: WJGR 2009, 00000058 p1; 2011, 00000047 p6; 2019, 00000160. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reus_van_Bickerseiland. Status: Wikipedia photos July 2021. Caveat: the paper gives 29 June 2010 and 2011 for the unveiling; Wikipedia "vanaf 2011": use 2011. Rank **Amazing**. New place.
title: De Reus van Bickerseiland

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-10 "De walvis" and the poem on the quay, Hollandse Tuin.** Pin 52.383269, 4.890133, waterside of the Hollandse Tuin. "Omgevallen boom" (1983) by Pieter Engels and Shlomo Koren, a slab of black granite with a half-round lid sawn out and tilted up, was meant as a fountain spraying a tree; the islanders call it "De walvis". The city later put three lamps in the basin without asking the artists. Fifty metres on, neighbour Carla Bogaards's lines from "Walk on water" are cut in orange letters in the low quay wall (2006), after she defended them before the council committee. Local voice: Engels, "Met een slokje op zou ik er misschien ook wel een walvis in zien", and on the lamps, "Dat mag eigenlijk niet"; the poet, "Sommige mensen voelen aan de letters." Lead: WJGR 2007, 00000072 p3; 2011, 00000047 and 00000048 p3. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Omgevallen_boom ; https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hollandse_Tuin_(Amsterdam). Status: Wikipedia photos August 2020. Rank **Nice**. New place (the poem as its Look for).
title: "De walvis" and the poem on the quay, Hollandse Tuin
rank_text: Rank **Nice**. New place (the poem as its Look for).

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-11 Tuin Bickersgracht Noordkop, the bird board and the yellow submarine.** Pin 52.385765, 4.888761 (pin approximate, north head of Bickerseiland by children's farm De Dierencapel, Bickersgracht 207). A neighbour-kept "tuinreservaat" of about 200 m2 since 2000: pond, fruiting shrubs, floating bird islands with a chick gangplank, and a board of 50 bird species drawn by two neighbourhood designers (2014); in 2015 the group fought a plan to fell the trees. The children's farm next door was saved by a 2006 campaign and has its own Sint Maarten animal lanterns. Amsterdamian's writer calls it her lunch spot "where the yellow submarine is anchored". Local voice: "een van de mooiste plekjes op aarde"; "als je naar boven kijkt waan je je bijna in een bos". Lead: WJGR 2014, 00000027 p7; 2015, 00000010 p9; 2019, 00000161 p4. Second: https://amsterdamian.com (Amsterdam Gardens post, 2025 or later). Status: garden 2019, farm in every 2026 issue. Caveat: the submarine is a private boat; outcome of the tree plan not found. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Tuin Bickersgracht Noordkop, the bird board and the yellow submarine

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-12 The Oranjeboom on the Zandhoek.** Pin 52.387918, 4.889912 (pin approximate: the fenced tree in the quay row by Zandhoek 10). A royal lime planted in September 1898 for Wilhelmina's inauguration, photographed by Jacob Olie, born at Zandhoek 10. Local voice (columnist): "Destijds was het een kleine boom met een vrij groot hek ... nu een grote boom met een vrij klein hek", and "lekker handig om je fiets aan vast te maken". Lead: WJGR 2018, 00000146; 2020, 00000186 p4. Second: none found (nl.wikipedia Zandhoek silent). Status: March 2018. Caveats: which tree needs a look on site (the fence is the clue); where Olie lived in 1898 is unclear. Rank **Nice**. New place (with the Stolpersteine at Zandhoek 12 and the 2013 resistance stone at Zandhoek 10 as Look for).
title: The Oranjeboom on the Zandhoek
rank_text: Rank **Nice**. New place (with the Stolpersteine at Zandhoek 12 and the 2013 resistance stone at Zandhoek 10 as Look for).

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-13 Kunstroute Nieuwe Houttuinen.** Pin 52.384283, 4.885467 (Jonas en de walvis). Behind the Haarlemmerdijk, the street the paper calls "een weg van niks naar nergens" became a small art route because one resident minded a bronze stuck in an underpass: Nic Jonk's "Jonas en de walvis" (1968, moved from the Beursplein, neighbours held a "doopfeestje" on 8 July 2016), Eja Siepman van den Berg's "Grote Staande" moved into a flower bed, Henk Ples's mosaic put up in 2016 thirteen years after his death, stripes on Hertzberger's porch pillars, the eye-twisting "Evergreen" foil (1996) in the underpasses against urinating and dumping, and the gable stone "Het walvisbeen is nu steen". Lead: WJGR 2016, 00000028. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jonas_en_de_walvis_(Amsterdam) ; https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evergreen_(Amsterdam). Status: Jonas photo August 2022, Evergreen August 2022. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Kunstroute Nieuwe Houttuinen

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-14 Jacob van Lennep and the first water tap.** Pin 52.385039, 4.882875, behind the Haarlemmerpoort. Lia van Vugt won a commission in 2004 for a bronze on a fountain that was never built; twelve years later she made a steel-and-glass statue for this spot (2016), on a plinth so no bikes can be chained to it. In 1851 the first dune water was tapped here, a cent a bucket for those without a house connection (the second tap was on the Noordermarkt, see DW-05). Local voice: "Sommige mensen zullen denken: 'Wie is dat nou weer?' Anderen vinden dat dat wel eens tijd werd"; the verse plaques fell off soon after the unveiling. Lead: WJGR 2016, 00000006 and 00000028 p8. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standbeeld_voor_Jacob_van_Lennep. Status: photo May 2021. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Jacob van Lennep and the first water tap

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-15 Door wind bewogen beweging (Wicher Meursing).** Pin 52.388139, 4.891889, Westerdoksdijk between Westerdok and IJ. A tall wind-driven sculpture built after Meursing's death in May 2015 by friends from his design model and paid by them; unveiled 28 August 2015. The paper says it should have stood on Bickerseiland, where his great-grandfather had a yard. Local voice: "Daar krijgt het de kans om de wonderlijkste bewegingen te maken, en om soms doodstil te staan". Lead: WJGR 2015, 00000012. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Door_wind_bewogen_beweging. Status: photo August 2021. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Door wind bewogen beweging (Wicher Meursing)

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-16 't Bronzen vingertje, Eenhoornsluis.** Pin 52.381219, 4.889363 (pin approximate, western abutment, south side). A tiny bronze finger for Nel de Jager (1953 to 2019), street manager of the Haarlemmerbuurt; prised out months after the 2021 unveiling, replaced on 29 July 2023 with a heavier anchor after fifty people crowdfunded. Local voice: "Voor de lezers met kwade bedoelingen: afblijven!". Lead: WJGR 2023, 00000202. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eenhoornsluis. Status: July 2023. Rank **Okay**. New place, or a Look for line at the bridge (the bridge also has one of the first Amsterdams Peil marks on the east quay wall, WJGR 2011, 00000049).
title: 't Bronzen vingertje, Eenhoornsluis
rank_text: Rank **Okay**. New place, or a Look for line at the bridge (the bridge also has one of the first Amsterdams Peil marks on the east quay wall, WJGR 2011, 00000049).

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-17 The Blauwburgwal bomb, 11 May 1940, and the stone with 44 names.** Pin 52.376621, 4.890038, plaque in the Blauwburgwal front of the 1952 corner block (Blauwburgwal 17 to 19 / Herengracht 107). At "vijf voor elf" on Saturday 11 May 1940 a German bomber dropped four bombs here: seven houses and Jan Pelle's brown café wiped out, 44 dead and 79 wounded, then largely forgotten. Retired chemical engineer and neighbour Fred Geukes Foppen, volunteering on a cause-of-death study, found the "bominslag" certificates, named all 44 (aged 6 to 72) and traced relatives; residents raised the money through Centrum Begroot and the stone was cut into the existing hardstone base of the corner building; Job Cohen unveiled it at 10.54 on 11 May 2020. Flowers are laid every year at 10.55; since 2022 the 4 en 5 mei comité runs it. One bomb did not explode and still lies in the mud of the Herengracht. Local voice: front-page cartoon "Zeg, die Geukes Foppen… liet de bom niet in een doofpot stoppen"; slogan "HET GEDENKTEKEN MOET ER KOMEN!". Lead: Zeven 118 p4, 121 p2, 124 pp2 to 3, 127 pp2 to 3, 131 p7, 135 p7. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bombardement_op_Amsterdam_(1940) (with the unexploded bomb, after NRC 7 December 2019); https://nos.nl/artikel/2170971-slachtoffers-onbekend-amsterdams-bombardement-krijgen-een-naam ; AT5 11 May 2022 (https://www.at5.nl/artikelen/215111). Status: plaque photographed March 2022; flowers May 2023 (Zeven 139). Rank **Amazing**. New place.
title: The Blauwburgwal bomb, 11 May 1940, and the stone with 44 names

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-18 The gaper of Het Heertje, now "O Johnny".** Pin 52.376994, 4.889168, Herenstraat 7. A drugstore gaper by Joop Mackenbach (1980s) was stolen in November 2016; the "kale haak" stayed in the wall while the neighbourhood paper demanded its return. A replica by Rein Veldboer hung from 2018 until July 2020, when a mocking social-media remark set off a row about its black face and the shop took it down. Sculptor Adriaan Rees, who became a sculptor because of gapers, rang the bell with an offer, and in 2021 his "O Johnny" went up: a two-faced figure with a Medusa head of green-yellow tongues and drugstore tubes, only the pill on the tongue recalling the old gaper. Local voice: "de kale haak in de muur van Herenstraat 7 bleef ons al die tijd herinneren aan dit gevoelige verlies"; the neighbours' reactions to "deze opzienbarende nieuwkomer lopen nogal" apart (Zeven 133). Lead: Zeven 114, 119 p3, 128 p7, 133 pp1 and 9. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaper_Oh_Johnny (photo June 2024); NH Nieuws 2020: https://www.nhnieuws.nl/nieuws/269910 ; DutchNews 2020: https://www.dutchnews.nl/2020/07/gap-where-gaper-was-after-amsterdam-drugstore-image-accused-of-being-racist-caricature/. Status: June 2024. Caveat: sensitive; tell it factually. Rank **Amazing**. New place.
title: The gaper of Het Heertje, now "O Johnny"

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-19 Bergstraat: De Naaister and the corn measurer who came home.** Pin 52.375490, 4.889598, Bergstraat 6 (the gate beside it). The residents' own facade bronze "De Naaister" by Caroline Kampfraath (2017), modelled in foam and cast with the foam texture, marks the street's change from window brothels and sewing workshops; and in autumn 2018 the gable stone of corn measurer Jan Stevens (bought here 1608: scoop, measure and strike-stick, "aan de strijkstok blijven hangen") returned after the house was demolished in 1955 and a neighbour spotted the stone in 2013 in the hall of the Korenmetershuis. Local voice: "Voortkomend uit een breed gedragen bewonersinitiatief heeft het beeld immers ook vele trotse 'eigenaren'." Lead: Zeven 116 p7, 117 p7, 124 p1. Second: none found yet (the statue list has a different "Naaister"). Status: 2018 to 2019; 2025 advert (Zeven 147) still names "het beeld De Naaister in de Bergstraat". Caveats: house number of the statue not printed (pin approximate); unveiling date unclear. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Bergstraat: De Naaister and the corn measurer who came home

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-20 Descartes at Westermarkt 6.** Pin 52.374880, 4.884448, Westermarkt 6. A plaque with his line on Dutch freedom ("Quel autre pays où l'on puisse jouir d'une liberté si entière?") marks the house of 1624 where Descartes lived in the summer of 1634 and, by his own note, fathered a daughter with the housekeeper Helena Jans; since 2019 a pavement tile in front reads "Ik denk, dus ik ben" (Humanistisch Fonds tiles project). Local voice: "Van Descartes rest de gevelsteen aan het huis van zijn grensoverschrijdend gedrag". Lead: Zeven 122 p5, 128 p4, 129 pp1 to 2. Second: to find (nl.wikipedia Westermarkt). Status: 2020. Caveat: beside the A-list Westerkerk: pitch on itself. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Descartes at Westermarkt 6

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-21 Herenstraat 21: Meijer and Regina Turfkruier.** Pin 52.377154, 4.888725, Herenstraat 21. Two Stolpersteine laid at 11.00 on 28 January 2026 for the cigar maker and his wife, murdered in Auschwitz, at the request of the shopkeepers who opened here in 2023 and researched the house; inside, a memorial with Regina's only surviving objects, a ring and a silver purse. Zeven 129 notes only one other stumbling stone in Buurt 7 (Langestraat 84). Lead: Zeven 150 p3. Second: to find (stolpersteine-amsterdam). Status: January 2026. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Herenstraat 21: Meijer and Regina Turfkruier

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-22 Waterline, the red climber on the Leliegracht quay.** Pin 52.375300, 4.888800 (pin approximate, quay wall at the corner Leliegracht and Herengracht). A bright red figure by French activist James Colomina hangs from the quay wall, a child painting a waterline far above today's level; it appeared unannounced in November 2025 with a second figure ("I'm fine") floating face down in a canal. Local voice: "Op 'n dag was ie er opeens"; the columnist reads it as "Apeldoorn aan Zee". Lead: Zeven 152 p1. Second: Reuters via Press TV, 7 November 2025 (https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2025/11/07/758355/Amsterdam--climate-red-salute). Status: September 2026. Caveats: probably temporary (outlook), exact spot on site. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Waterline, the red climber on the Leliegracht quay

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-23 Lekkeresluis, "de brug van tante Mie".** Pin 52.380459, 4.887954 (pin approximate, the bridge at Prinsengracht and Brouwersgracht). From 1849 floating pay toilets ("retirades", after Sarphati) hung under several bridges, a cent a visit, kept by "meisjes van de retirade"; the one under this bridge was tante Mie's, "ook wel Kakke Mie", and Jordaan girls skipped rope to her rhyme into the 1950s. Local voice: "Onder de brug van tante Mie / Daar kan je kakken voor een spie / Als je dan geen cent betaalt / Word je door de stront gehaald". Lead: WJGR 2021, 00000192 p4. Second: none found (nl.wikipedia Lekkeresluis silent). Status: gone, the bridge is there. Caveat: gone thing, only the spot; whether Mie punished non-payers is not known. Rank **Okay** (Nice for copy). New place (status Gone) or a line for the bridge.
title: Lekkeresluis, "de brug van tante Mie"
rank_text: Rank **Okay** (Nice for copy). New place (status Gone) or a line for the bridge.

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-24 Eerste Marnixplantsoen: the bastion in the grass and the 1966 riot.** Pin 52.381636, 4.880075 (pin approximate, the park). The only spot on the Singelgracht that still has a bastion's pointed shape; the mill De Palm stood on it. On 14 June 1966 the Bouwvakkersoproer ("ook wel het vierde Jordaanoproer") began in front of 1e Marnixplantsoen 1, then a patronaat where building workers cashed holiday vouchers. Since 2005 a skate pool a nine-year-old named "Sk8scape HighFly". Local voice: "Eén van de meest roemruchte plekken uit de Jordaanhistorie". Lead: WJGR 2006, 00000080 p10; 2008, 00000066 and 00000067 p11. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marnixplantsoenen ; https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telegraafrellen. Caveat: bastion name (paper "De Palm", Wikipedia "bolwerk Haarlem"); nothing marks 1966. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Eerste Marnixplantsoen: the bastion in the grass and the 1966 riot

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-25 Noorderspeeltuin on the Carthusian graveyard.** Pin 52.379542, 4.882705 (pin approximate), Tweede Lindendwarsstraat 10. "Waarschijnlijk de oudste nog bestaande vereniging in de Jordaan" (1908), with the pointed-roof huts in the Karthuizersplantsoen, a drum band and majorettes; it lies on the former Karthuizer churchyard, where the real Jan Claassen (born 1664 in the Anjeliersstraat) and Catrijn Pieters, the quarrelling couple behind the puppet show, are "vermoedelijk" buried. Local voice: "Wie kent ze niet, de gebouwen met de kenmerkende puntdaken"; on Katrijn: "in werkelijkheid sloeg ze met alles wat ze te pakken kon krijgen". Lead: WJGR 2007, 00000073 p7; 2008, 00000071 p1; 2017, 00000128 p11. Second: none found. Status: named in every 2026 issue. Caveat: the burial is the paper's "vermoedelijk". Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Noorderspeeltuin on the Carthusian graveyard

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-26 Schoone Weespad and Vuile Weespad.** Pin 52.371845, 4.878814 (Vuile Weespad entrance, Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat 38); the Schoone Weespad opposite. Two inner gardens of the Zuid-Jordaan kept by neighbours: the "Schoone" one with rock garden, fruit trees and grapes ("blijft in discussie" whether city fruit is edible), the "Vuile" one a courtyard where residents fought a 9-metre extension in 2009 and 2010 and where hofjes concerts are held. Local voice: "een oase in de Jordaan ... gevrijwaard van verstening"; on the extension, "Een monsterlijk gedrocht". Lead: WJGR 2005, 00000089 p5; 2010, 00000052 p4; 2014, 00000026; 2017, 00000112; 2026, 00000223. Second: none found. Status: concerts 2026. Caveat: access outside events unclear (Still there? and opening). Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Schoone Weespad and Vuile Weespad

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-27 Nassaubioscoop, the Moorish front on the Lijnbaansgracht.** Pin 52.380486, 4.881181, Lijnbaansgracht 31. A 1913 cinema-variety with three horseshoe arches, closed 1933, then timber trade, supermarket and years behind green netting; the Jordaanmuseum wanted it as its home and lost; behind it the slum houses of the Berengang were threatened in 2017. Local voice: "Op één curieus pand aan de Lijnbaansgracht na"; "wie maakt van dit krot weer een pareltje van de Jordaan?". Lead: WJGR 2017, 00000111 and 00000133 p5; Binnenstad 233 (2009) "Een neomoors geveltje aan de Lijnbaansgracht". Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nassaubioscoop (converted from 2020). Status: converted 2020; front's state to check. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Nassaubioscoop, the Moorish front on the Lijnbaansgracht

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-28 Delverssteeg and the Sevenhuysengangh.** Pin 52.369431, 4.879591, Elandsgracht 114. Behind the right-hand door was for four centuries the entrance of a covered alley of about 1614 to nine small houses on the Delverssteeg, backing onto the Zeemtouwerssloot (filled about 1875, now Lijnbaansstraat); the alley survives as back yards. Local voice: residents say the old paving of the steeg still lies under the gravel. Lead: WJGR 2007, 00000075 p3; 2010, 00000056 p5. Second: none found. Caveat: private yards; one sees the door and the little houses in the Lijnbaansstraat. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Delverssteeg and the Sevenhuysengangh

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-29 Looiersplantsoen, the toddlers' square run by neighbours.** Pin 52.368708, 4.879915 (pin approximate, Tweede Looiersdwarsstraat). Since 31 March 1994 three residents run it under contract with the city, one of the first self-management schemes, locking the gate at night and netting the sandpit against cats. Local voice: the twenty-year tally, "twee tuinhuisjes versleten ... veertien zandbakvullingen, veertig bezems ... één paar klompen". Lead: WJGR 2014, 00000025. Second: none found. Status: 2014. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Looiersplantsoen, the toddlers' square run by neighbours

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-30 "Gallisch dorp" Groenmarkt.** Pin 52.370703, 4.875273, Marnixstraat 210 (block 200 to 220). Residents fought demolition for seven years until the block was listed, and threw a street party on 6 June 2008. Local voice: headline "'Gallisch dorp' viert zijn overwinning". Lead: WJGR 2008, 00000067 p1 and 00000071 p8; 2010, 00000053 p4. Second: monument register to check. Rank **Okay**. New place or merge with the monument record.
title: "Gallisch dorp" Groenmarkt
rank_text: Rank **Okay**. New place or merge with the monument record.

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-31 De Roode Bioscoop, the anarchists' cinema.** Pin 52.384082, 4.883977, Haarlemmerplein 7. A cinema since 1 September 1913, run by anarchist Gerhard Rijnders to spread "het rode gedachtegoed met films"; later rehearsal room of street-theatre group Flint; the name painted on in 1987 by founder Felix Strategier; a volunteer stage and polling station. Fights: a doubled rent in 2010 ("Red de Roode Bioscoop!") and in 2024 the landlord claimed the name ("Buurtmonument onder vuur", court case). Local voice: "een begrip in de Jordaan en voor heel Amsterdam". Lead: WJGR 2010, 00000052 p1; 2024, 00000211 p1. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/De_Roode_Bioscoop. Status: programme in 2026 issues; outcome of the case unknown (outlook: Under threat). Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: De Roode Bioscoop, the anarchists' cinema

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-32 The Movies, "klein Tuschinski".** Pin 52.384014, 4.884632, Haarlemmerdijk 161. Founded as Bioscope Tavenu (1912 in the 2014 issue, opened 12 October 1915 in the 2023 issue), later Cinema Hollandia, The Movies since 1971; "de oudste nog in gebruik zijnde bioscoop van Amsterdam", nicknamed for its art deco interior. Restored with a 50,000-euro crowdfund and reopened 13 March 2023. Lead: WJGR 2014, 00000023 p11; 2023, 00000202. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Movies_(Amsterdam) (founded 1912 as Bioscoop Tavenu, Hollandia two years later, "Klein Tuschinski"). Caveat: the 2023 issue gives 12 October 1915: use 1912 with Wikipedia. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: The Movies, "klein Tuschinski"

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-33 Haarlemmerpoort: a gate that never guarded anything.** Pin 52.384820, 4.883667. Built 1838 to 1840 when the walls were already gone, opened for Willem II and so officially "Willemspoort"; excise office, police post, squatted in 1978, homes from 1986, residents moved out by Ymere in 2017 despite protest; Stadsherstel took over in 2018 and let donors "adopt" parts of it (the clock's gold had been pecked off by birds). Local voice: "een klassieke Romeinse triomfboog, met een zuilengalerij waar iedere Amsterdammer doorheen kan wandelen". Lead: WJGR 2012, 00000044; 2018, 00000156 p3; Binnenstad 289 (2018). Second: nl.wikipedia Haarlemmerpoort. Caveat: listed and known; this is a merge candidate with the monument record. Rank **Okay**. Merge.
title: Haarlemmerpoort: a gate that never guarded anything

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-34 Stones that came home: Bickersgracht 14 and 22.** Pins 52.384345, 4.888777 ('t Smalschip, 1671) and 52.384498, 4.888775 (in Vreelant, 1664). "in Vreelant" vanished during a restoration and turned up in 2020 in the wall of a dentist's house in Moordrecht, whose predecessor had bought it from a dealer; both were bricked in again in 2021 and 2022. Local voice: "De stenen zijn thuisgekomen". Lead: WJGR 2022, 00000198 p3; Binnenstad 300 (2020). Rank **Okay**. New place (group).
title: Stones that came home: Bickersgracht 14 and 22

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-55 Prinseneiland: the last walwindas and the Palmentuin.** Pin 52.385612, 4.887171 (pin approximate, Prinseneilandsgracht at the Galgenstraat, by the Sloterdijkbrug); Palmentuin at Prinseneiland 40 (52.384952, 4.887800). On the quay stands the wooden cover of a shore winch for hoisting tar barrels from boats, "De enige overgebleven walwindas in onze stad" according to an island guide; an old resident remembers playing among the tar barrels here, "De windas herinnert nog aan die tijd". The Palmentuin is one of the neighbour-made gardens of the islands (since the 1990s, with the Bickeltuin). Lead: WJGR 2010, 00000053; 2017, 00000111; 2021, 00000192. Second: https://www.amsterdamsights.com/about/western-islands.html (winch cover near the Sloterdijkerbrug; Palmentuin "semi-public"). Status: 2017 (winch); garden 2021. Caveat: exact spot of the winch on site; garden access. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Prinseneiland: the last walwindas and the Palmentuin

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt and the Western Islands
text: **DW-35 Toon Ylandplantsoen, "ons klein Keukenhof".** Pin 52.387683, 4.887394 (pin approximate, end of the Vierwindenstraat). An orphaned strip by the water turned into a neighbours' garden; in 2016 the city named it, behind his back, after its gardener of 25 years. Local voice: "door de buurt 'ons klein Keukenhof' genoemd; die groene parel van het Realeneiland". Lead: WJGR 2016, 00000004. Second: none found. Status: 2016. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Toon Ylandplantsoen, "ons klein Keukenhof"

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-36 Zon's Hofje, behind an ordinary front door.** Pin 52.378172, 4.887054, Prinsengracht 159 to 171. A door one pushes open onto a hofje on the site of the hidden Mennonite church De Kleine Zon; from the 1750s or 1760s for older Mennonite women, now young women students; under the clock the gable stone of Noah's ark. Local voice: "Wanneer boven die deur niet een witgele gevelsteen met de naam Zon's Hofje had opgelicht, was je nummer 159-171 zo voorbij gelopen." Lead: Zeven 100 p3, 110 p5. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zon%27s_Hofje (church redundant 1752, first women 1765, MDCCLXV date stone with a sundial and a verse by Bernardus de Bosch). Caveat: opening hours to check. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Zon's Hofje, behind an ordinary front door

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-37 Westerkerkhof gate with the mourning putti.** Pin 52.374600, 4.883600 (pin approximate, Prinsengracht side left of the Westertoren). The paupers' graveyard ran from the Keizersgracht to the Prinsengracht, was closed after the plague of 1655 and absorbed into the market; the Homomonument now stands on it. Its classicist gate with weeping putti stands on the Prinsengracht side. Lead: Zeven 114 pp1 to 2. Second: to check (Westerkerk article). Caveat: beside the A-list church; pitch on the gate. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Westerkerkhof gate with the mourning putti

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-38 Zuid-Afrikahuis and the "boekverdrinking".** Pin 52.375868, 4.886855, Keizersgracht 141. Europe's largest library on South Africa, in the house of the ZASM foundation, which (says the paper) grew from what was left of the British compensation for the seized Dutch railway in the Transvaal. In January 1984 some forty masked "Autonomen" tied up the staff and threw books into the Keizersgracht, a "boekverdrinking" condemned "door vriend en vijand"; reopened after renovation in February 2016. Lead: Zeven 115 pp3 to 4. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zuid-Afrikahuis (19 January 1984, anti-apartheid activists threw hundreds of books into the canal; water damage repaired only in 2014). Status: 2016 reopening; study room and events. Caveat: the paper dates the house purchase to 1909, Wikipedia has the library move in in 1950 at the invitation of Stichting ZASM: say "since 1950" for the library. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Zuid-Afrikahuis and the "boekverdrinking"

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-39 Keizersgracht 177: the slave traders' house where Amnesty works.** Pin 52.374481, 4.885613. Balthasar Coymans laid the first stone (gold-lettered stone at the entrance, MDCXXV); the family grew rich on the slave trade; later the first HBS of Amsterdam and the Lely Lyceum; now Amnesty International. Local voice: the facility manager calls it "een middelvinger naar het verleden". Lead: Zeven 149 p1; Zeven 133 pp2 to 3 (22 WIC-elite addresses in Buurt 7). Second: to check (monument register; Mapping Slavery). Caveat: the paper confuses 1625 and 1635. Rank **Nice**. New place or merge with the monument.
title: Keizersgracht 177: the slave traders' house where Amnesty works
rank_text: Rank **Nice**. New place or merge with the monument.

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-40 Groenlandse Pakhuizen: whale oil on the Keizersgracht.** Pin 52.378691, 4.888547, Keizersgracht 40 to 44. The 1621 warehouses (originally five) of the Noordse Compagnie held some sixty tanks of whale oil "tot grote ergernis van de buurt", and slabs of blubber were dumped on the quay; Michiel de Ruyter sailed to Jan Mayen as mate in 1633 and 1635. The Noordsche Compagniebrug is the other trace. Lead: Zeven 134 p1. Second: monument register. Rank **Okay**. Merge with the monument.
title: Groenlandse Pakhuizen: whale oil on the Keizersgracht

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-41 Keizersgracht 384: Vondel's gate.** Pin 52.369279, 4.883983. The gate of Jacob van Campen's first Schouwburg (opened 3 January 1638 with Gijsbreght van Aemstel), the only part left after the fire of 1772, still carries Vondel's "De weereld is een schouwtooneel". Lead: Zeven 150 p2. Second: to check. Rank **Nice**. New place or merge.
title: Keizersgracht 384: Vondel's gate

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-42 Klipper Bestevaer at the head of the Keizersgracht.** Pin 52.378900, 4.888600 (pin approximate, Keizersgracht at the Brouwersgracht corner). A two-masted clipper of 1906, restored to its old look as a home, "als een baken" at the start of the Keizersgracht; storm Poly snapped both masts on 5 July 2023 when an elm fell on it, about fifty neighbours came by, and new masts came from Harlingen over the IJ in February 2024. Local voice: owner, "Het schip heeft 120 jaar lang woeste stormen doorstaan, maar kwam in de Keizersgracht zijn Waterloo tegen"; neighbours: "hé, je lampjes doen het weer!". Lead: Zeven 140 p4, 143 p7. Second: none found. Status: February 2024. Caveat: private home afloat; seen from the bridge. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Klipper Bestevaer at the head of the Keizersgracht

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-43 De Notendop, the Tuesday duet with the Westertoren.** Pin 52.374900, 4.884000 (pin approximate, Prinsengracht at the Westerkerk). On Tuesdays at noon Reinier Sijpkens moors his home-built music tub at the foot of the tower and answers the carillon on trumpet; a hatch in the clock face opens and the carillonneur waves; then he collects "bruggeld" in a clog on a fishing rod. Local voice: Sijpkens, "bruggeld is erfgoed, 't zit in onze genen"; a resident: "als je de trompet in de verte hoort, raak je helemaal geroerd...!". Lead: Zeven 115 pp4 to 5; Zeven 138 p3 (last concert before the restoration, 21 March 2023). Second: none found. Status: 2023; whether it resumed after the tower's restoration is unknown (Still there?). Caveat: a ritual, the tower is A-list. Rank **Nice** if running, else drop.
title: De Notendop, the Tuesday duet with the Westertoren

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-44 Multatuli's birth house, Korsjespoortsteeg 20.** Pin 52.377461, 4.891101. A museum since 1975 run by volunteers, three days a week, with his own desk and belongings, saved by his second wife who outlived him by forty years; the bust on the Torensluis is "die bronzen kop van Multatuli midden in onze buurt". Lead: Zeven 104, 145 p4, 148 p7. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multatuli_Huis. Status: 2025. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Multatuli's birth house, Korsjespoortsteeg 20

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-45 Hermanusje van Alles, the drugstore of window puns.** Pin 52.378423, 4.882587, Westerstraat 138 (OSM). An independent drugstore where the owner has worked since 1973; shelves of old products (stove polish, a baby scale, an eau de cologne pump, a "Juliana 70 jaar" bottle), and for fifty years a window pun changed every two months (a Mars bar under "Loop naar de maan" = "Protestmars"; a fitting without bulb = "Mistlamp"), collected in a book in its third printing. Local voice: "Mensen fietsen om voor onze drogisterijdrop." Lead: Zeven 146 pp3 to 4 (2025). Second: OpenStreetMap (name and address only); none found for the facts. Status: 2025. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Hermanusje van Alles, the drugstore of window puns

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-46 Perlee, the street organ workshop.** Pin 52.378182, 4.883016, Westerstraat 119. Begun 1875 by Leon Warnies in the Egelantiersstraat, renting small organs "met een aapje erbij"; at no. 119 since 1932; in 2008 the family lodged the showpieces with the national museum in Utrecht but kept them playing in the street. Local voice: "Ik ben in het vak geboren"; "Vanaf mijn dertiende hielp ik mee de draaiorgelboeken te maken. En dat doe ik nog steeds." Lead: WJGR 2008, 00000067 p3; 2018, 00000153 p7. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/G._Perlee_Draaiorgelmuseum. Status: 2026 agenda. Caveat: visits by appointment. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Perlee, the street organ workshop

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-47 Pianola Museum, the one the neighbours saved.** Pin 52.378598, 4.883584, Westerstraat 106. Self-playing pianos in a former police post; when the city wanted to sell the building, a petition gathered 19,500 signatures (2018) and the sale was "voorlopig van de baan". Local voice: a neighbour, "Ik wist helemaal niet dat hier een muziekgebouw zat!" (2009). Lead: WJGR 2009, 00000061 p5; 2013, 00000038; 2018, 00000146 and 00000149; 2020, 00000186. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geelvinck_Pianola_Museum. Status: concerts in 2026 agendas. Caveat: outlook (rent, ownership). Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Pianola Museum, the one the neighbours saved

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-48 Electric Ladyland.** Pin 52.375618, 4.880796 (OSM), Tweede Leliedwarsstraat 5. Nick Padalino's fluorescent cave (1987), built over seven years, where visitors push the buttons; "Het enige ter wereld" says the paper. Lead: WJGR 2016, 00000006 p4. Second: OSM museum node; Atlas Obscura type lists. Status: 2016; check opening. Rank **Nice** if open. New place.
title: Electric Ladyland

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-49 Joost Swarte's "Parels van de Jordaan", Willemsstraat 204.** Pin 52.381020, 4.882469. A housing block of 2010 by the cartoonist with a string of charms in the stairwell, each a Jordaan object or story. Binnenstad ran two pieces side by side: "Jordanees monument in de dop?" and "Schokkende aantasting van de Willemsstraat" (April 2010), after "Cartoonesk bouwplan in de Willemsstraat" (2009). Lead: WJGR 2010, 00000062 p10; Binnenstad 232 and 239. Second: https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Willemsstraat_(Amsterdam). Status: building there; charms visible? Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: Joost Swarte's "Parels van de Jordaan", Willemsstraat 204

heading: Jordaan
text: **DW-50 The phone box library, Boomstraat.** Pin 52.379323, 4.885073 (pin approximate, Boomstraat). A writer won Centrum Begroot (4,246 votes) to replace her open give-away shelf with a 1933 Brinkman and Van der Vlugt type phone box with a solar panel; the street keeps it. Local voice: "Daar woont een schrijver... En dat is onze straatboekenkast"; the note on the pane, "ALLEEN VOOR BOEKEN EN NIET VOOR JAPANSE EETSTOKJES OF DE IKEA GIDS VAN 2004". Lead: WJGR 2020, 00000185 p4; 2021, 00000194 p5. Second: none found. Status: November 2021. Caveat: in front of a living person's home; pitch the box. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: The phone box library, Boomstraat

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt
text: **DW-51 De Mof, workwear since 1885.** Pin 52.383177, 4.886093, Haarlemmerdijk 109. German Ferdinand Holzhaus opened a shop in workmen's clothes in 1885 (khaki overalls for carpenters, blue for metal workers, white for painters, the corduroy "klettervest" of coal men); the neighbours nicknamed him "de mof" and he named the shop after it; above it the 1734 gable stone SLUYS. Purveyor to the court since 2011; calls itself "de oudste kledingwinkel van Amsterdam". Local voice: "Voor de buurtbewoners was natuurlijk al gauw de bijnaam de Mof verzonnen." Lead: WJGR 2010, 00000055 p8; 2015, 00000014; 2019, 00000164; 2026, 00000223. Second: none found. Status: 2026. Caveat: the name is a wartime slur; handle the copy with care. Rank **Nice**. New place.
title: De Mof, workwear since 1885

heading: Haarlemmerbuurt
text: **DW-52 Het Groene Hoofd aan het IJ.** Pin 52.387722, 4.892573 (pin approximate, plateau by the Goedkoop building, Westerdoksdijk). Two residents turned a concrete mooring platform of shipping firm Gebr. Goedkoop into six planters edged with stone from the city depot and six benches (Centrum Begroot, 17,500 euro), shovelling the grit themselves. Local voice: "Dat gesleep met emmertjes met grit heeft ons het meeste werk gekost". Lead: WJGR 2022, 00000197; 2026, 00000226 p1. Second: none found. Status: November 2026. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: Het Groene Hoofd aan het IJ

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-53 De Afstap, the wool shop that kept its name.** Pin 52.374619, 4.888607 (pin approximate, Oude Leliestraat 7: number not printed). Fifty years in November 2023; started in a souterrain (a step down, "afstap") on the Leliegracht, then the Brouwersgracht, now the Oude Leliestraat; knitted 60 fisherman's sweaters for Peter Grimes and 100 Fair Isle sweaters for Soldaat van Oranje; advertised in the buurtkrant for 44 years. Local voice: "dé wolwinkel van Amsterdam". Lead: Zeven 140 p3, 150. Second: none found. Rank **Okay**. New place.
title: De Afstap, the wool shop that kept its name

heading: Grachtengordel-West
text: **DW-54 Rien Bekkers's costume dolls, Herenstraat.** Pin approximate, Herenstraat (number not printed).
